# Will this tour make money? Find out before you book the van

> Free band tour profit planner. Enter your shows, venue deals (flat, door or versus), miles, rooms and merch and see profit per show and for the tour, break-even attendance, the guarantee to ask for and which dates to drop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
